name: Vampire Hunter
source:
Chris is a hunter who seeks only for one prey - the vampire Lark who slaughtered all his family. There are six possible outcomes of this confrontation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
克里斯是一名猎人，他只寻找一个猎物——屠杀了他全家的吸血鬼云雀。这场对抗有六种可能的结果。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
